source: map.meshcore.io public nodes API (https://map.meshcore.io/api/v1/nodes), type 2 = Repeater per the map's own src/config.js NODE_TYPES
scope: New England (lat 41.0-47.5, lon -73.7 to -66.9), repeaters only
caveats: Only nodes someone chose to upload appear; setting a location is optional.
Positions can be blurred by the node owner.
Entries include stale/duplicates/test nodes; this file keeps only repeaters whose last_advert is within 20 days (the map's own extinct threshold) to avoid padding with extinct entries.
A dot does NOT mean a working path from Braintree — it means the repeater advertised itself and published a location.
Radio params are as published by the node; most New England repeaters use the USA/Canada (Recommended) preset: 910.525 MHz, SF7, BW 62.5, CR5.
One entry (QUI - Whitwell Repeater, Quincy) carries a last_advert of 2026-11-28, three days after this fetch — recorded as published; likely a clock error on that node.
